hypothesis: Lesion-aware AAL3 regional radiomics and homologous nonlesional contrast preserve localized signal diluted in whole-region descriptors
cohort: Frozen 198 V5 complete cases; unchanged original clinical labels
reference: Whole homologous AAL3 region, excluding lesion dilated by 2 MNI voxels; paired by anatomical names, not numeric parity. This is not a mirrored lesion-shaped ROI.
absence: No lesion: zeros. Affected but too small or missing reference/texture: NaN plus explicit availability indicators; train-only median imputation.
texture: 93 PyRadiomics Original features, V5 settings; lesion intersect AAL3, only >64 valid voxels and >=2 nonsingleton dimensions
L: Eight lesion first-order descriptors and eight homologous contrasts per AAL3 region plus availability flags
T: 93 lesion-intersection radiomics per AAL3 region plus availability flags
W: V5 whole-region radiomics multiplied by that region's lesion fraction; unaffected regions zero
baseline: C core + volume + global availability + training-selected 20 AAL3 burden + training-selected global lesion radiomics; identical V5 B_R__unclip_p99

modelling.original: V1 LightGBM/RFE/SMOTE, separate block selection inside each training fold
modelling.secondary: ExtraTrees 400 trees min_samples_leaf=5 max_features=0.7 balanced; logistic L2 C=0.1 balanced; all train-preprocessed columns, no supervised screening
modelling.fusion: Direct concatenation; additionally fixed 0.75 baseline + 0.25 regional-only probability blend for V1 model
modelling.primary: mRS V1 baseline+L versus V1 baseline
modelling.selection: No outer-fold protocol/model/weight selection. Report every fixed comparison, exploratory cohort reuse acknowledged.
modelling.uncertainty: 2000 stratified paired patient bootstraps of averaged OOF predictions; conditional, not full retraining or research-selection uncertainty
